formula: y' = y + K sin(2πx) + epsilon sin(10πx), x' = x + y' mod 1

beta.method: Multi-start gradient descent for the finite-period action; smallest action retained.
beta.displayCurve: Least-squares projection of the sampled values onto a strictly convex discrete curve.
beta.caveat: Finite-period numerical approximation only; not a certification of Mather's beta function.

phase.method: 64 uniformly spaced initial conditions on theta=1/2, each drawn for 6000 iterates.
phase.caveat: Finite iterates in a displayed y-window; visible curves are not proofs of KAM tori.
